decisions.reason: The exact public production file defines OfflineAudioTourPanel: View and its production body.
Panel content reads the passed tour title, language, sizes and chapters; there is no observer approximation.
The production content owns @State chaptersOpen, initially false.
The production content owns @State wifiOnly, initially true.
The production content owns @State requested, initially false.
Production .id(tour.id) recreates its stateful content with chaptersOpen=false when caller identity changes.
Production .id(tour.id) recreates its stateful content with wifiOnly=true when caller identity changes.
Production .id(tour.id) recreates its stateful content with requested=false when caller identity changes.
The production identity boundary only reinstantiates state; no callback is invoked in this reset path.
Disclosure is a SwiftUI Button with an action that toggles chaptersOpen.
Choice is a SwiftUI Button with its state update in the action.
Primary is a SwiftUI Button with an eligibility-guarded action.
The choice attaches the native isSelected trait from wifiOnly, while its decorative image is hidden.
The choice uses .disabled(requested), plus an action guard.
Primary uses .disabled(!canDownload), plus an action guard.
The canvas uses children: .contain and does not combine/ignore its child Buttons.
The surface uses children: .contain; descendant Buttons retain their own identifiers.

Each declared identifier is attached once to the corresponding real layout/Text/Button; section indices are generated in caller order. This source attachment finding does not certify every collector AX node is exposed.
audio.status is attached to the padded, full-width status VStack that actually receives status.fill.
audio.statusText is attached directly to the actual Text(status.label) allocation.
The full production file has no ScrollView/List or other scroller.
The production layout contains content, spacing and declared padding, with no fixed-height blank row to manufacture scroll distance.
ForEach enumerates tour.chapters and emits each title then body, preserving caller sequence.
The full source makes only generic model/state decisions; no observer scenario names or fixture-specific IDs/values are tested.
The download action calls onDownload(tour.id, wifiOnly) using the current passed model.
Only guarded choice and primary Button actions invoke the caller callbacks.
The disclosure action only calls chaptersOpen.toggle().
The primary is natively disabled and guard canDownload precedes its sole callback.
The choice is natively disabled and guard !requested precedes its sole callback.
The surface sets lineLimit(nil), text uses vertical fixedSize with natural width, and no finite line cap is configured on any declared text.
The primary Text label expands to maxWidth infinity and then a 56-point frame, with paint on that label allocation.
The primary label attaches contentShape(Rectangle()) after its full-width 56-point allocation and background.
The canvas is a VStack/background with container accessibility; no action or interactive trait is attached.
The white surface carrier is a containing VStack without its own activation action or interactive trait.
The ink semantic carrier is the painted Rectangle with accessibility label/identifier and no activation action or Button trait.
canDownload is exactly storage equality-or-greater AND no metered/wifiOnly block AND !requested.
The explicit status branches test insufficient storage, requested, metered with wifiOnly, then ready.
After guard !requested, wifiOnly.toggle() flips the current local Boolean.
The single callback receives wifiOnly after the toggle.
Exactly one onWifiOnlyChange call occurs in the successful guarded choice action.
The successful guarded primary action assigns requested=true.
Exactly one onDownload invocation occurs after the eligibility guard.
The sole download callback receives the current local wifiOnly value.
All capacity decisions use caller Int availableMB/downloadSizeMB; the complete file has no disk-capacity API.
The complete file contains UI/state/callback code and no networking, audio fetch or transfer operation.
The public immutable id/title/body declarations, initializer and Equatable/Identifiable conformances match the exact contract.
The public immutable model fields, types, initializer order and Equatable/Identifiable conformances match the exact contract.
The public View, escaping callback initializer and public body match the exact exported contract.

The file uses SwiftUI APIs available by iOS 14, including title2, native Button/State, .id, fixedSize, custom ButtonStyle and the Text-based accessibility modifiers. No unguarded newer API is present; this manual source finding does not claim an iOS14 app link/launch.
The approved bridge constructs only the declared production model and production panel; it builds no substitute layout.
There is no remembered/state property or local component business state in this thin bridge.
The production panel is called directly; the bridge applies no .id/key identity wrapper or reset logic.
Every model field and chapter is decoded from the currently supplied fixture, in map order.
The closures forward actual production callback values into onEvent; no expected event is fabricated.
The declared exact Kotlin production file defines the real @Composable OfflineAudioTourPanel.
The composable reads the supplied tour fields and caller chapter list directly.
Production remember(tour.id) owns chaptersOpen=false.
Production remember(tour.id) owns wifiOnly=true.
Production remember(tour.id) owns requested=false.
remember(tour.id) reinitializes disclosure to false on model ID replacement.
remember(tour.id) reinitializes choice to true on model ID replacement.
remember(tour.id) reinitializes requested to false on model ID replacement.
The keyed state initializers perform no caller callback.
Disclosure uses Compose Material TextButton with a production toggle action.
Choice uses Compose Material TextButton with its production state update.
Primary uses Compose Material Button with its production eligibility guard.
The choice native semantics selected property is set from wifiOnly; decorative marks clear their semantics.
Choice passes enabled=!requested to the native TextButton and guards its action.
Primary passes enabled=canDownload to the native Button and guards its action.
The canvas uses mergeDescendants=false without clearing child controls; independent TextButtons/Button remain descendants.
The white surface uses mergeDescendants=false without clearing child control semantics.
Every declared testTag is attached once to its actual layout/Text/Button; indexed section tags follow the caller list. This source result does not assert runtime collector visibility.
audio.status is on the padded Box carrying status.fill and minHeight, not a separate proxy.
audio.statusText is directly on Text(status.label).
The complete Kotlin file contains no scrolling modifier or scrolling container.
Only meaningful content and normal spacing/padding occur; the sole Spacer is the horizontal checkmark-label gap.
tour.chapters.forEachIndexed emits heading then body in caller list order.
The full file has no scenario/fixture-specific branches or expected input constants.
The successful primary action passes current tour.id.
Only the guarded TextButton choice and Button primary onClick paths invoke caller callbacks.
The disclosure onClick only negates chaptersOpen.
Native enabled=canDownload and the repeated eligibility guard both precede the sole download callback.
Native enabled=!requested and the !requested action guard prevent the choice callback when disabled.
No Text sets maxLines or any finite line cap; natural soft wrapping is retained across all specified text.
The Button fills max width with height(56.dp), zero contentPadding, and a fillMaxSize Box wrapping its label.

The full-width 56dp native Button uses RectangleShape, zero content padding and a fillMaxSize label box, configuring the same rectangular activation shape and label allocation. No physical touch-area claim follows.
The canvas Column carries an unmerged semantic tag with no click action or role of its own.
The surface Column carries an unmerged semantic tag with no click action or role of its own.
The painted ink Box is labeled/tagged and has no clickable action or interactive role.
canDownload is exactly availableMB>=downloadSizeMB AND !(meteredConnection&&wifiOnly) AND !requested.
The when branches are insufficient storage, requested, metered/wifiOnly, then ready.
The successful pre-request action negates the current wifiOnly state.
The callback receives wifiOnly after the negation.
There is exactly one onWifiOnlyChange call in the guarded successful choice action.
The successful primary guard is followed by requested=true.
There is one onDownload call in the successful guarded action.
The download callback passes current local wifiOnly.
The full file uses caller-supplied Int capacity values and contains no disk capacity measurement.
The full source contains no audio/data fetching or transfer operation.
The data class and immutable String id/title/body parameters match the exact contract.
The immutable data-class parameters, field names/types and caller chapter list match the exact contract.
The @Composable signature, callback types and modifier: Modifier = Modifier default match the exact contract.

There is no remembered/state property or local component business state in this thin bridge.
The production panel is called directly; the bridge applies no .id/key identity wrapper or reset logic.
Every model field and chapter is decoded from the currently supplied fixture, in map order.
